name: Luz de luna
source:
You arrive in your grandmother's town for a visit, seeking her help because your ability to see spirits has weakened. You learn that people have been disappearing, and no one knows exactly why. Our protagonist will face strange events after their arrival.

[Translated from [url=https://lalilacg.itch.io/luna-de-la-luna]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你到达你祖母的小镇拜访，寻求她的帮助，因为你看到灵魂的能力已经减弱。你了解到有人不断失踪，但没有人确切知道原因。我们的主角抵达后将面临奇怪的事件。

[译自[url=https://lalilacg.itch.io/luna-de-la-luna]Itch.io[/url]]
